item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Merge paragraph versions, not complete documents.","mechanism":"Per-paragraph causal histories distinguish sequential edits from concurrent alternatives, including deletion versus editing.","implementation":"Attach two-device revision vectors to edits. Merge by stable paragraph ID; retain concurrent text versions or deletion tombstones with authorship.","check":"Replay independent edits in both arrival orders; both survive. Concurrent edits retain identical original texts and author/device labels.","risk":"Scalar logical revisions alone cannot establish causality."},{"action":"Separate paragraph movement from paragraph text.","mechanism":"Independent position metadata lets text edits survive reordering without treating movement as replacement.","implementation":"Assign sortable fractional position keys. Concurrent moves of one ID use a deterministic revision/device tie-break; equal positions sort by paragraph ID.","check":"Replay opposing moves and simultaneous text edits in both orders; paragraph order converges, IDs remain unique, and edits survive.","risk":"Position keys can grow; avoid unsynchronized renumbering."},{"action":"Make conflict resolution explicit and attributable.","mechanism":"A resolution supersedes only the alternatives the user reviewed, never an unseen concurrent edit.","implementation":"Show original alternatives, authors, devices, and deletion status. Save the user's choice or combined text with referenced version IDs and causal context.","check":"Resolve two alternatives, then deliver an unseen concurrent edit; it must reappear as a conflict without overwriting the resolution.","risk":"Premature history cleanup can erase explanations or unresolved text."},{"action":"Persist and replay an idempotent edit journal.","mechanism":"Durable operations and acknowledged revision ranges support delayed exchange through the existing transport without duplicate application.","implementation":"Persist operations before acknowledging local saves; deduplicate by device/revision. Retain unacknowledged history throughout offline periods rather than expiring it at 48 hours.","check":"From one snapshot, script independent edits, opposing moves, and deletion versus editing; replay both reconnect orders, duplicates, and crashes. Compare states and conflict originals.","risk":"Unbounded edit volume requires storage monitoring; paragraph limits do not bound history."}],"abstention_reason":""}
